summary: Comprehensive testing of Demo Mode feature for AI Doctor Assistant Dictation System. All 4 backend tests passed (100%). All 15 frontend UI elements verified successfully. Fixed a bug in server.py where json module was referenced in except block before import.

issues: Microphone access denied message shows in headless browser - expected behavior

passed_tests: Frontend: Demo Mode toggle is visible on AI Consultation page (data-testid='demo-mode-toggle')
Frontend: Clicking Demo Mode toggle shows 7 sample cards (data-testid='demo-samples')
Frontend: Demo sample cards show all 7 labels: Respiratory Infection, Hypertension Follow-up, Acute Gastroenteritis, Prescription Only, Lab Orders, Dermatology Follow-up, Uncertain Medication
Frontend: Demo sample badges show correct modes: Full SOAP, Rx Mode, Orders Mode, Review Flags
Frontend: Clicking pneumonia demo sample (data-testid='demo-sample-pneumonia') triggers AI processing
Frontend: Pipeline status shows 'AI Processing' during processing and 'Review Required' after completion
Frontend: After demo processing, transcript panel is visible with dictation text (data-testid='transcript-panel')
Frontend: After demo processing, structured output shows Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan sections with Insert buttons
Frontend: 'Insert Full SOAP' button appears in structured output (data-testid='insert-full-soap')
Frontend: Clicking 'Insert Full SOAP' populates all SOAP fields in the center editor
Frontend: Review flags/warnings appear when AI detects uncertainties (amoxicillin formulation, prescription quantity)
Frontend: Clear button (data-testid='demo-clear-btn') resets demo state and shows samples again
Frontend: Recording controls (mic button) are hidden when Demo Mode is enabled
Frontend: Toggling Demo Mode off restores recording controls (mic button visible)
Backend: POST /api/dictation/structure in 'prescription' mode returns prescriptions array with Azithromycin extracted
Backend: POST /api/dictation/structure in 'orders' mode returns orders array with CBC, urinalysis, FBS, lipid profile, chest x-ray
Backend: POST /api/dictation/structure with uncertain medication produces review_flags and uncertainties
Backend: Demo mode creates dictation session with ai_processed status for audit trail
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: server.py line 2371 - json module was imported inside try block but referenced in except block, causing UnboundLocalError. Moved import to top of file.
Demo Mode implementation is clean with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
AI structure endpoint properly extracts prescriptions in Rx mode and orders in Orders mode
Review flags are correctly generated for uncertain/ambiguous dictations
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create dictation sessions for demo samples during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo Mode feature fully tested. Key demo samples: pneumonia (full SOAP), prescription (Rx mode), orders (orders mode), uncertain (produces review flags). AI processing takes 7-10 seconds. All 7 demo cards match DEMO_SAMPLES constant in AIConsultationPage.js lines 51-107. Demo creates real dictation sessions for audit trail.
